parsed.summary: The PR introduces a change to ensure deterministic output for KernelPCA with the rbf kernel, but it may have unintended side effects.

issues.description: The change to flip eigenvectors' sign may introduce a behavioral regression risk, as it alters the output of the algorithm in a way that could affect downstream applications.
The PR does not include any new tests to verify the correctness of the change, which could lead to undetected issues in the future.
